_about: Training settings of every adapter in the paper. Each value is copied from the code; '_source' gives file:line in this repository.

base_models._source: scripts/final_round.sh:61-66 (function model); powerbrain/core.py:455-457 loads them with transformers

lora.vision_encoder: frozen (the target modules lie in the language model only)
lora._source: powerbrain/train_lora.py:243 (rank 16), :261 (alpha = 2 x rank, dropout 0.05, bias none), :262 (target modules)

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: cosine with warm-up of max(10, total_steps // 20) steps
optimizer._source: powerbrain/train_lora.py:242 (lr), :306 (AdamW, weight decay 0), :309 (cosine schedule and warm-up)

pack._note: the share 0.2 is the list-dropping rate nu of Algorithm 1

tiers._note: 4B rows use the medium detector, 2B rows the nano detector (cands_*_v1 and cands_*_nano, scripts/final_round.sh:54-56, used at :175-178)

final_round_switches._source: written once with `bash scripts/final_round.sh config ...`; the accepted values are checked at scripts/final_round.sh:385-386, the meaning of each switch is at scripts/final_round.sh:9-14; the values used are those of the authors' run record
